units: Num. R. s. 108 (ref. to Num. VI, 3) והלא יין הוא ש׳ וש׳ וכ׳ are not yayin and shekhar the same?; יין זה חי וש׳ זה מזוג yayin is unmixed wine, and shekhar is mixed wine; a. e.—Esp. beer of dates or barley.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:1">Pes. III, 1</cite> <he>ש׳ המדי</he> Median beer, expl.
<cite ref="Pesachim 42b:3">ib. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>דרמו ביה מי שערי</he> date beer into which they put a concoction of barley.
<cite ref="Pesachim 107a:10">Ib. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מקדשין על הש׳</he> you must not pronounce the Ḳiddush (<cite ref="S00873"><he>קִידּוּשׁ</he></cite>) over beer; a. fr.
